title: Relaxing suite in the heart of Green Hills
description:
Nestled in the heart of Nashville’s Green Hills neighborhood, is a sanctuary of beauty, wellness, and inspiration. Come experience this beautifully feng shui’d home that will nurture, rejuvenate and balance your mind, body, and spirit while you stay here. Find serenity as you mediate in the lush zen gardens or as you bird watch in the backyard. We are 1 mile from Blue Bird Cafe. 4 miles from Music Row. 8 miles to Downtown.

The space
This home was designed by legendary mid-century architect, Joseph Elchler, and is the perfect blend of mid-century simplicity, wellness retreat and laid back living. 

As a Feng Shui designer, healer, and artist, I've weaved serenity and peace throughout this home. Strategically placing crystals has brought positive energy to every corner. With personal care, I handpicked each item, plant, and color to clear negativity, rebalance your energy, and awaken inspiration. Welcome to this enchanting sanctuary—a place where transformation and creativity intertwine.

Other things to note
You must be 25 years or older to rent. Primary renter must be in residence for rental period. This is a quiet family neighborhood. This is not a “party place”.
